DELIVERY, RISKS AND EVIDENCE BOUNDARIES
3. Delivery milestones
Day 1 is the kickoff after approval and confirmation of a delivery owner. These milestones are separate from
the voting dates configured in the DAO interface.
Deadline
Deliverable
Day 7
Publish an accessible draft guide and the workshop plan.
Day 14
Complete two workshops and collect voluntary participant feedback.
Day 21
Publish the final guide and a report summarizing attendance, feedback and unresolved
issues.
4. Success criteria
Deliver two workshops and a final participation guide. Record actual attendance against the planned target of
30 participants. Include at least five worked examples covering proposal interpretation, PDF citations, wallet
safety, vote confirmation and database-to-chain comparison. Report feedback without claiming a
predetermined improvement score.
5. Risks and mitigations
Risk
Planned mitigation
Low attendance
Share invitations early and offer a recorded walkthrough.
Wallet or transaction confusion
Use test wallets and guided examples; never request private keys
or recovery phrases.
Misunderstanding AI answers
Show source excerpts and explain that citations require inspection.
RPC or network interruption
Use saved examples clearly labeled with their observation time.
Personal information in feedback
Collect only necessary information and publish aggregated
findings.
6. Governance and evidence boundaries
Voting options are Approve, Reject and Abstain. Actual member assignments, voting dates, vote totals and
final outcome must come from the application and contract after proposal creation. This PDF does not specify
a quorum percentage, an on-chain proposal ID, a contract address or transaction hashes.
This is synthetic data for a live software demonstration. The document describes proposed activities and
targets; it does not prove that workshops occurred, 30 people attended or the budget was approved. Approval
does not automatically release funds or execute contract changes. No password or API credentials are
provided.
